title: Register a non-government school
what: Conduct a non-government school for children of compulsory school age only if the school is registered.

sources.title: Education Act 1990 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct or knowingly permit or assist in the conduct of a school (other than a government school) for the education of children of compulsory school-age unless the school is registered under this Division
